description: Find work email candidates for a person at a company: pass `full_name`, or `first_name` and/or `last_name`, together with the company `domain`. Each candidate has a validation verdict in `validity` — `valid`, `invalid`, `catchall`, `malformed` or another value; only `valid` is confirmed deliverable. `limit` caps the number of candidates (1–10). The result has the full v3 answer in `data`, the credits charged for the call in `creditCost` and the `requestId` to quote to support.

domain.description: Company domain to scope the lookup.

limit.description: Maximum number of email candidates to return.

name: find_work_emails
title: Find Work Emails
